author: Till Theato
name: cr2hdr
description: Runs the cr2hdr tool on selected images to process Magic Lantern Dual ISO captures and imports the results as group leaders.
description-extensive: If you shoot with Magic Lantern's Dual ISO feature on Canon cameras, this script automates the conversion of those special files into usable high-dynamic-range images. You trigger it with a keyboard shortcut on selected photos, and the converted versions are automatically imported and shown in place of the originals. It requires the cr2hdr conversion tool from the Magic Lantern project.
